verdict.rationale: Archive handling is a fair format-coverage question for a batch conversion tool, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence shows ImageMagick extracting or repacking ZIP, 7z or RAR archives. The documented formats are image formats only (PNG, JPEG, WebP, AVIF, HEIC, TIFF), and the one mention of zips concerns how the Windows build is distributed, not something the product does.

support.subject: As a power user, archives (ZIP, 7z, RAR) extract and repack as part of a conversion
